effectgroup.name: OuzFX AFX_Move_Text_Typewriter_Wipe_Slow_Out
effectgroup.description: Backspace-style exit: a linear right-to-left crop erases the line over 50 frames (mirror of Text_Typewriter_Wipe_Slow). Razor 50 frames before the end of the clip and drop it on that last piece – the layer is gone on the last frame (anything after stays hidden).
